description_en: Verifies whether the name, mobile phone number, and ID card number at a specified time belong to the same user
description_zh: 用于验证指定时间点的姓名、手机号和身份证号是否属于同一用户
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi history-three-elements-verification --auth-code example --input-number example --mask example --name example --cert-code example --verification-time example --api-version 2020-02-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: HistoryThreeElementsVerification

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code. Value sources:
Select the ID Card Three Elements tag in the Tag Marketplace (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/square) of the Phone Number Dictionary console and submit an application. After the application is approved, you will obtain an authorization code.
View the approved authorization ID for the ID Card Three Elements tag on the My Applications (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply) page of the Phone Number Dictionary console
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。取值来源：
在号码百科控制台标签广场 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/square)选择身份证三要素标签，提交使用申请，申请通过后会获得授权码。
在号码百科控制台我的申请 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)页面，查看已申请通过的身份证三要素授权ID
parameters.name: auth_code

parameters.help_en:
The phone number to be queried.

If the Mask parameter is set to NORMAL, this field is an 11-digit mobile phone number

待查询的号码。

若Mask取值为NORMAL，该字段为11位手机号码
parameters.name: input_number

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method. Valid values:

NORMAL: No encryption
parameters.help_zh:
加密方式。取值：

NORMAL：不加密
parameters.name: mask

parameters.help_en:
The ID card number to be verified.

If the Mask parameter is set to NORMAL, this field is in plaintext
parameters.help_zh:
待核验的身份证号。

若Mask取值为NORMAL，该字段为明文
parameters.name: cert_code

parameters.help_en: The historical verification time, accurate to seconds. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmss. If the time is not accurate to seconds, fill the hour, minute, and second parts with 000000. Note: For example, 20230615000000 indicates the verification of the ownership relationship on June 15, 2023
parameters.help_zh: 历史核验时间，精确到秒。格式：yyyyMMddHHmmss。 如果没有精确到秒的信息，时分秒部分填充 000000。 说明 例如：20230615000000 表示核验 2023 年 6 月 15 日的持有关系
parameters.name: verification_time

parameters.help_en:
The specified carrier code. This parameter is optional. If you specify a carrier, the system schedules the query to the specified carrier. If you do not specify this parameter, the system schedules the query to the home carrier of the phone number by default.

Valid values:
`CMCC`: China Mobile
`CUCC`: China Unicom
`CTCC`: China Telecom

Note: Due to mobile number portability, when a number is ported, the system does not know which carrier the input phone number belongs to at the target time point. Therefore, this parameter is provided for you to specify as needed. If you do not specify this parameter, the system queries the home carrier of the number. If you specify this parameter, the system queries based on the specified carrier.

Important Specifying China Broadnet is not supported. If you specify China Broadnet, a 400 error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
指定运营商编码。非必填参数，当客户指定运营商入参时，系统按客户指定的运营商方向进行调度查询。不传则默认按号码归属运营商进行调度。

取值：
`CMCC`：中国移动
`CUCC`：中国联通
`CTCC`：中国电信

说明 由于携号转网的存在，当某个号码存在携转时，系统并不知道入参的手机号在目标时间点归属在哪个运营商，因此开放此参数供客户按需指定。如客户不传，系统以号码归属运营商查询；如客户传了，则以客户定义的入参查询。

重要 不支持指定广电运营商，传入将返回 400 错误
parameters.name: carrier

IsConsistent.description_en:
Indicates whether the verification result is consistent. Valid values:
0: No record found.
1: The mobile phone number, ID card number, and name are all consistent.
2: The mobile phone number and ID card number are consistent, but the name is inconsistent.
3: The mobile phone number and name are consistent, but the ID card number is inconsistent.
4: The mobile phone number is consistent, but the ID card number and name are inconsistent
IsConsistent.description_zh:
验证结果是否一致。返回：
0：查无记录
1：手机号、证件号、姓名均一致
2：手机号和证件号一致，姓名不一致
3：手机号和姓名一致，证件号不一致
4：手机号一致，证件号和姓名不一致
